verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: eyebrow and headline, then copy, then the can, then the CTA. It keeps the can recognizable and the peach circle as a brand cue. But the '20% off' headline is small, the Shop Sale button is pushed up to the top edge, and the legal text is cramped against the right edge. B splits '20% off' onto two lines, separates 'WEEKEND ONLY' from the headline and parks it above the button, and wraps the body copy into a cramped three-line block. It also shrinks the can to an unrecognizable speck and jams the legal text against the button with almost no gap.
